navigationGrouping: Local editorial navigation groups over official IPTC Genre concepts; group labels are not IPTC terms.

roots.label: Factual news and coverage
roots.description: Straight reporting, news updates, event coverage, context, profiles, summaries and retrospectives.

children.label: Background
children.description: Scene setting and explanation for an event being reported

children.label: Behind the Story
children.description: The content describes how a story was reported and offers context on the reporting

children.label: Biography
children.description: Facts and background about a person

children.label: Current Events
children.description: Content about events taking place at the time of the report

children.label: Exclusive
children.description: Information content, in any form, that is unique to a specific information provider.

children.label: Feature
children.description: The object content is about a particular event or individual that may not be significant to the current breaking news.

children.label: From the Scene
children.description: The object contains a report from the scene of an event.

children.label: History
children.description: The object content is based on previous rather than current events.

children.label: Obituary
children.description: The object contains a narrative about an individual's life and achievements for publication after his or her death.

children.label: Profile
children.description: The object contains a description of the life or activity of a news subject (often a living individual).

children.label: Retrospective
children.description: The object contains material that looks back on a specific (generally long) period of time such as a season, quarter, year or decade.

children.label: Scener
children.description: The object contains a description of the event circumstances.

children.label: Side bar and supporting information
children.description: Related story that provides additional context or insight into a news event

children.label: Special Report
children.description: In-depth examination of a single subject requiring extensive research and usually presented at great length, either as a single item or as a series of items

children.label: Summary
children.description: Single item synopsis of a number of generally unrelated news stories

children.label: Synopsis
children.description: The object contains a condensed version of a single news item.

children.label: Update
children.description: The object contains an intraday snapshot (as for electronic services) of a single news subject.

children.label: Wrap
children.description: Complete summary of an event

children.label: Wrapup
children.description: Recap of a running story

roots.label: Analysis and commentary
roots.description: Opinion, researched analysis, advice, reviews, forecasts, fact checks and satire.

children.label: Advice
children.description: Letters and answers about readers' personal problems

children.label: Analysis
children.description: Data and conclusions drawn by a journalist who has conducted in depth research for a story

children.label: Fact Check
children.description: The news item looks into the truth or falsehood of another reported news item or assertion (for example a statement on social media by a public figure)

children.label: Forecast
children.description: The object contains opinion as to the outcome of a future event.

children.label: Opinion
children.description: The object contains an editorial comment that reflects the views of the author.

children.label: Press-Digest
children.description: The object contains an editorial comment by another medium completely or in parts without significant journalistic changes.

children.label: Review
children.description: The object contains a critique of a creative activity or service (for example a book, a film or a restaurant).

children.label: Satire
children.description: Uses exaggeration, irony, or humour to make a point; not intended to be understood as factual

roots.label: Announcements and schedules
roots.description: Notices, upcoming event previews, schedules, listings and calls for reader information.

children.label: Advisory
children.description: Recommendation on editorial or technical matters by a provider to its customers

children.label: Birth Announcement
children.description: News of newly born children

children.label: Curtain Raiser
children.description: Information about the staging and outcome of an immediately upcoming event

children.label: Daybook
children.description: Items filed on a regular basis that are lists of upcoming events with time and place, designed to inform others of events for planning purposes.

children.label: Fixture
children.description: The object contains data that occurs often and predictably.

children.label: Help us to Report
children.description: The news item is a call for readers to provide information that may help journalists to investigate a potential news story

children.label: Program
children.description: A news item giving lists of intended events and time to be covered by the news provider. Each program covers a day, a week, a month or a year. The covered period is referenced as a keyword.

roots.label: Interviews and statements
roots.description: Dialogue, interviews, direct quotations, answers and verbatim transcripts.

children.label: Interview
children.description: The object contains a report of a dialogue with a news source that gives it significant voice (includes Q and A).

children.label: Question and Answer Session
children.description: The object contains the interviewer and subject questions and answers.

children.label: Quote
children.description: The object contains a one or two sentence verbatim in direct quote.

children.label: Response to a Question
children.description: The object contains a reply to a question.

children.label: Transcript and Verbatim
children.description: A word for word report of a discussion or briefing

roots.label: Reference and data
roots.description: Fact lists, survey results, statistics, almanac entries and horoscopes.

children.label: Horoscope
children.description: Astrological forecasts

children.label: Listing of facts
children.description: Detailled listing of facts related to a topic or a story

children.label: On This Day
children.description: List of data, including birthdays of famous people and items of historical significance, for a given day

children.label: Polls and Surveys
children.description: The object contains numeric or other information produced as a result of questionnaires or interviews.

children.label: Results Listings and Statistics
children.description: The object contains alphanumeric data suitable for presentation in tabular form.

roots.label: Supplied and sponsored content
roots.description: Press releases and content supplied, funded or sponsored by an outside party.

children.label: Advertiser Supplied
children.description: Content is supplied by an organisation or individual that has paid the news provider for its placement

children.label: Press Release
children.description: The object contains promotional material or information provided to a news organisation.

children.label: Sponsored
children.description: Content is produced on behalf of an organisation or individual that has paid the news provider for production and may approve content publication

children.label: Supported
children.description: Content is produced with financial support from an organisation or individual, yet not approved by the underwriter before or after publication

roots.label: Media and archive formats
roots.description: Audio or other media forms and material reused from an archive.

children.label: Actuality
children.description: Recording of an event

children.label: Archival material
children.description: Material selected from the originator's archive that has been previously distributed

children.label: Music
children.description: The object contains music alone.

children.label: Raw Sound
children.description: The object contains unedited sounds.

children.label: Text only
children.description: The object contains a transcription of text.

children.label: Voicer
children.description: Content is only voice
